Scp11KeyParameters copies the certificate collection but retains each certificate and the EC private-key reference, then disposes those same objects. Its public key is retained without disposal. Record with-expressions can share the contained disposable owners. XML calls OceKeyRef required for a/c although the constructor does not require it, and claims empty/null b fields while the full constructor accepts supplied values for b.
original_definition.desired: B6 should describe construction/containment/disposal and alias lifetime explicitly, and reconcile required-versus-optional metadata with its actual SCP initializer. Cross-reference the same ownership in Security Domain/OpenPGP/PIV examples. Keep record cloning and disposed-alias policy as consequential decisions rather than changing APIs in Pass 1.
original_definition.primary_owner: B6-wire-scp; applet-specific caller dispositions stay with boundary owners
original_definition.confidence: high for narrowly inspected containment boundary; no wire, certificate-profile or full B6 audit
original_definition.final_observation: Narrow Scp11X963Kdf dependency read supports current C provider-test assertions: exported D arrays, shared-secret arrays, concatenation owner and receipt buffers have separate finally scopes; receipt comparison failure and provider Dispose failure are modeled in existing tests. No full SCP wire review or GlobalPlatform-source download was undertaken. Parameter-clone/certificate containment facts and initializer OCE-reference/profile questions remain B6 referrals, with source hashes and unchanged-path disposition retained. HsmAuth CLI shared callers omit deviceContext.SessionOptions; boundary owners should compare that with intended SCP/presence option propagation rather than C claiming universal callback adoption.
